answer: Retroactive cluster correlation audit compares action fingerprints across a rolling horizon, flagging dense groups whose timing and request sequences match. Above threshold, it voids the cluster's past rewards and charges each member a levy equal to ten times median reward, confirmed against a Sonnet-generated baseline. Attackers then pay that per-identity levy plus shared cluster forfeiture at the wharf settlement layer, making N sybils cost roughly N levies plus one cluster-wide loss.
